items.body: The raw `clone` call assumes flags are the first argument on every Linux architecture. [s390 selects `CLONE_BACKWARDS2`](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/arch/s390/Kconfig#L136), whose [syscall takes the stack before flags](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/kernel/fork.c#L2731-L2735). Consequently, s390x receives `SIGCHLD` as the stack address and zero flags, breaking both supervisor creation and ordinary `waitpid` ownership.
items.suggestion: Supply the architecture-specific argument order for s390x and verify the raw-fork ABI for each admitted architecture.
items.title: The raw `clone` call assumes flags are the first argument on every Linux architecture

items.body: PATH resolution selects the first executable regular file before attempting `execve`. If that file has a missing shebang interpreter or an incompatible executable format, execution fails even when a later PATH entry contains a working executable. The previous Python supervisor [attempted every prepared PATH candidate](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/3.13/Modules/_posixsubprocess.c#L770-L783). This changes successful launches into status 1.
items.suggestion: Prepare all candidate pathnames in the parent, then iterate their `execve` attempts in the child, preserving the baseline error-selection behavior. Add a control with an unusable first candidate and a working second candidate.
items.title: PATH resolution selects the first executable regular file before attempting `execve`
